description: A feature and maintenance update introducing a quality switcher, metadata enhancements, and code modularization for improved performance.

logs.desc: Added a quality switcher to the episode player.
"Content Views" and "Content Rating" to information page.
Improved player code quality and maintainability by modularizing scripts, reducing single-file length from ~1k lines to a maximum of 347 lines.
"contentRating" to "contentAgeRating" to use "contentRating" as the rating of an anime instead of rating of min age of the content.
